data.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: task-5 RED tests use FIXTURE dd*.json files with locked schemas (from task-2 data contract section), NOT live outputs from task-1..4 execution. Schema fixtures defined in tests/unit/scripts/fixtures/dd_locked_schema_v1/dd{1,2,3,4}.json. Each fixture contains the canonical schema shape with synthetic pass+fail values. task-5 RED test set: (a) all-pass fixtures → dd5.json overall_result=true; (b) dd2_pass=false fixture → overall_result=false; (c) any per-DD field missing → exit non-zero with diagnostic. This makes task-5 RED tests independent of task-1..4 implementation timing and immune to upstream schema drift.
